title: The Coffee Pot
description: An SMP server with a small community building our forever world. We play Vanilla+ with economy, land claim, and questing. We are also slowly growing with extra features. The server is run on a network to allow for additional worlds (creative/hardcore).
body:
**Grab a mug and settle in at The Coffee Pot! ☕ (18+ | Java & Bedrock 1.21.11)**

Looking for a mature, relaxed place to build your forever home? The Coffee Pot is a growing adult server where players can hang out, collaborate on shared projects, or just quietly solo-build their own empires in peace.

Our core experience is *Mundus Ultimus*, a Vanilla+ survival world with a player-driven economy and land claiming. We feature a relaxed set of rules (Be respectful, No griefing) so you can play exactly how you want.

When you need a break from survival, our network also offers:

* 🛠️ Creative & Adventure Servers: Jump into *Infinita Realitas* to test your designs, or explore *In Memoriam Devolution*.
* 🔥 Hardcore Server: We host a restricted-access, shared-life hardcore server, *Mors Communis*, for players looking for an extreme challenge.

Whether you play on Java or Bedrock, there's a warm spot waiting for you. Come build with us!

* Server IP: [mc.badc0ffe.net](http://mc.badc0ffe.net)
* Bedrock Port: 9009
* Discord: [https://discord.gg/ASZpEvdcFY](https://discord.gg/ASZpEvdcFY)
